[SWS_Fr_00249] ⌈The function Fr_PrepareLPdu() shall perform the following tasks
on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:
1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the processing of the
FlexRay frame identified by Fr_LpduIdx.
2. Configure the physical resource (a buffer) appropriate for Fr_LpduIdx opera-
tion (SlotId, Cycle filter, payload length, header CRC, etc.) if the MCG uses the
reconfiguration feature4.
3. Return E_OK.
⌋
